explanation: Cooks aim for pasta that is cooked through but still offers a slight bite at the centre. Risotto rice is cooked al dente too.

claims.text: The Italian phrase al dente means 'to the tooth'.
Al dente does not mean to the bone, to the heart or to the fork.
Pasta cooked al dente is cooked through but still slightly firm at the centre.
Risotto rice is also cooked al dente.
